g.text: Irradiance, illuminance and EDI describe different aspects of the same light.
D65 with the same melanopic irradiance
The spectral shape stays the same.
Illustrative numbers, not measurements. DER is undefined when Ev = 0. This does not predict an individual's response.
EDI and DER exist for all five α-opic assessments: melanopic, rhodopic, S-cone, M-cone and L-cone.
